definitions.explanation: A movie made primarily for enjoyment and mass appeal, as opposed to artistic or documentary films.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みには{娯楽映画|ごらくえいが}がたくさん{公開|こうかい}される。
examples.english: Many entertainment films are released during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: この{監督|かんとく}は{娯楽映画|ごらくえいが}と{芸術映画|げいじゅつえいが}の{両方|りょうほう}を{手|て}がけている。
examples.english: This director works on both entertainment films and art films.

examples.japanese: {昭和|しょうわ}の{時代|じだい}には{娯楽映画|ごらくえいが}が{日本|にほん}の{大衆文化|たいしゅうぶんか}の{中心|ちゅうしん}だった。
examples.english: In the Showa era, entertainment films were at the center of Japanese popular culture.

notes:
Composed of {娯楽|ごらく} (entertainment, amusement) and {映画|えいが} (film, movie). The term distinguishes commercial crowd-pleasers from {芸術映画|げいじゅつえいが} (art films) or {記録映画|きろくえいが} (documentary films). Japan's golden age of {娯楽映画|ごらくえいが} was the 1950s-60s, when studios like {東宝|とうほう}, {松竹|しょうちく}, and {東映|とうえい} produced a high volume of genre films.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {娯楽映画|ごらくえいが}の{大作|たいさく} — big entertainment film; blockbuster
- {娯楽映画|ごらくえいが}を{楽|たの}しむ — to enjoy an entertainment movie
- {娯楽映画|ごらくえいが}の{黄金期|おうごんき} — golden age of entertainment films

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {芸術映画|げいじゅつえいが} — art film; arthouse movie
- {記録映画|きろくえいが} — documentary film
- {商業映画|しょうぎょうえいが} — commercial film (emphasizes profitability over entertainment)
